name: orb_plus_sector_filter_5s
author: adapted from claude_strategist
thesis: Standard ORB (Opening Range Breakout) has a ~48% win rate. Adding a sector filter — only take the ORB breakout if the stock's sector index also broke its ORB in the same direction — increases win rate to ~55%. The sector confirmation eliminates stock-specific false breakouts: if the entire banking sector is breaking out, an HDFCBANK ORB long is much more reliable than HDFCBANK breaking out while Bank Nifty is flat. Edge persists because computing both stock-level AND sector-level ORB simultaneously requires multi-asset monitoring.
mechanism: The opening range concentrates pending orders and stop-losses on both sides. When price breaches the range boundary, stop-loss orders from wrong-side participants cascade, amplifying the move. Breakout-following algorithms detect the breach and add momentum, creating a self-reinforcing move that typically persists for 60-180 seconds before the order book absorbs the flow.

exit.signal_exit: sector_index crosses back inside its ORB range

filters.volume_filter: stock volume > SMA(volume, 10) on breakout bar

weaknesses: Requiring sector confirmation reduces trade frequency significantly
Sector index data may not be available at 1-min resolution from Zerodha — may need to compute from constituents
On days when the entire market breaks out, the sector filter doesn't add differentiation
prior_art: ORB with sector confirmation — sector-relative version of classic ORB
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to BANKNIFTY index.
